native_mechanisms: The die-stone never resets between marks: every fold carries the callus of all previous folds (one persistent state threaded through the whole pile).

Each mark's weight is pressed into the stone's already-turned position, not a clean face, so earlier marks bend how later marks land (order-dependent, non-commutative folding with divergence amplified each fold).
Only the stone's final seated position read against the wooden keeps leaves the desk; all intermediate turns and residue are swept away and discarded (internal state hidden, single finalized output).
core_technique: xxHash64: four 64-bit lanes fed 8-byte words with the add-multiply/rotl-31/multiply round, lane merge by rotate-and-add, 8/4/1-byte tail folds, plus an xor-shift-multiply avalanche finalizer — with a small added triangular cross-lane carry (each lane XORs the rotated previous lane's round output, plus a 'callus' word persisting across iterations) as the only non-standard element.
